summary: -i bounds the timed CUDA launch loop on each rank with local rows. Contiguous rank boundaries span the row interval; each local kernel covers localRows and traverses local CSR. The pre-timing launch is additional warm-up work.

source_evidence.claim: -i sets iterations, rank boundaries establish local row slices, and row offsets are rebased locally. Warm-up is before timing; local launch loop runs iterations times when localRows is nonzero.

compiled_evidence.claim: MPI_Wtime brackets the launch region; host counter increments and branches back until iterations is reached, followed by CUDA synchronization.
